items.title: A longer default day
items.body: New events now start with 16 hours of coverage, and the hours you choose do not change the price estimate.

items.title: Simpler choices
items.body: Edited photos offer 0, 300, 400, 600 or your own number, long videos start at 1, and photo books are chosen by number of photos.

items.title: See the paper size
items.body: Photo books and wall portraits now show a picture of the paper size on the card and beside each size in the list.

items.title: Recommended pricing on its own page
items.body: Recommended pricing now has its own page, between your budget and the final review.

items.title: A suggestion, not a rule
items.body: We suggest RWF 7,000,000 or more for organisations booking commercial, conference or wedding coverage in 4 days or less. You can offer any budget.

items.title: Less to scroll
items.body: The offer screen is shorter now: the Viewing as switch is gone, so there is less to scroll before you answer.

items.title: Answers side by side
items.body: Accept offer and Accept with my delivery package policy sit side by side, with Reject offer on its own row below.

items.title: Offers in the app look
items.body: The offer screens for photographers now use the same colours and fonts as the rest of Connekyt, in dark and light.

items.title: Nothing is cut off
items.body: Long details such as delivery dates and print products now wrap onto the next line instead of being cut short.

items.title: Plainer wording
items.body: Buttons now read Accept, Accept with my delivery terms and Decline, and extra explanations were removed.

items.title: Archived albums
items.body: An archived album now says when it was archived and what it costs to restore, with a confirmation before anything is charged. Archived albums are marked in your list and have their own filter.

releases.title: Offers that ring like a call

items.title: Full-screen offer calls
items.body: A new event offer now wakes a locked Android phone with a full-screen incoming call, even when the app is closed.

items.title: Opens over other apps
items.body: Allow Connekyt to appear over other apps and a new offer opens and rings right away, like a normal call.

items.title: Closing only minimizes
items.body: Going back from the first screen now tucks Connekyt away instead of closing it, so it stays ready for the next offer.

items.title: Ready after a restart
items.body: Connekyt now comes back by itself when your phone starts, so offers can ring without opening the app first.
